topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I take another drag from my cigarette, the nth one tonight. The rain’s relentless, matching my mood. Found the bucket list tucked away in an old drawer, where secrets fester. Paper’s yellowed, the ink faded, but the words hit like a sucker punch. Travel the world, skydive, learn to salsa. She never said a word, and there I was, thinking we were on the same page. Maybe she’s been living in a different chapter, one where I’m not the hero. I’ve seen how hopes and dreams can splinter when you least expect it, leaving a trail of shattered plans. Now, I stare at the list, wondering if I ever really knew her at all. Time to make some calls, see what I can dig up. Silence never tells the whole story, and neither does a piece of paper.
